Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded the final answer as A) erosion of the stream bank, misapplying hydrologic principles. In standard earth science, decreasing stream velocity lowers shear stress, capacity, and competence, which typically increases deposition (B) rather than erosion. The Planner anchored on niche pore-pressure/exposure-time arguments not appropriate for the general conceptual question and did not validate with authoritative sources before deciding, leading to the wrong solution.
